subtopics.title: Concentration — How Much Is Dissolved in How Much

questions.question: Concentration is defined as:
options: The mass of solute per mole of solution
The moles of solute per cubic decimetre of solution
The volume of solute per volume of water
The molar mass divided by the volume

questions.question: 4 g of NaOH (M = 40 g·mol⁻¹) is dissolved and made up to 500 cm³. The concentration is:

subtopics.title: Percentage Composition, Empirical and Molecular Formulae

questions.question: The percentage of oxygen by mass in CaCO₃ (M = 100 g·mol⁻¹) is:
A compound is 75 % carbon and 25 % hydrogen by mass. Its empirical formula is:
The empirical formula is best described as:
options: The simplest whole-number ratio of atoms in a compound
The actual number of atoms in one molecule
The formula including all the isotopes present
The formula of the compound in the gas phase

questions.question: A compound has empirical formula CH₂O and molar mass 180 g·mol⁻¹. Its molecular formula is:
In the tuck-shop picture, the mole is like a box because:
options: Every box weighs the same no matter what is inside
Every box holds the same count of particles, whatever the substance
Boxes can only hold atoms, not molecules

questions.question: A mole of hydrogen atoms and a mole of carbon atoms have:
options: The same mass and the same count
The same mass but different counts
The same count but different masses

questions.question: Converting grams to moles means asking:
options: How many particles fit in one gram?
How many full boxes is this mass, so divide the mass by the molar mass
How much space does the substance take up?

subtopics.title: Balloons Are Honest About the Count

questions.question: Two identical balloons at the same temperature and pressure, one with helium and one with air, contain:
options: More molecules in the air balloon because air is heavier
More molecules in the helium balloon because helium atoms are smaller

questions.question: The volume of a gas depends mainly on the number of molecules because:
options: Gas molecules expand to fill the space
A gas is mostly empty space, so the size of individual molecules barely matters
Heavier molecules take up more room
Gas molecules stick together in fixed clusters

questions.question: The balloon-ratio shortcut of reading coefficients as volumes may be used:
options: For any substances in a balanced equation
Only when every substance involved is a gas at the same conditions

questions.question: One scoop of concentrate in a small jug tastes stronger than in a huge jug because concentration is:
options: The amount of stuff divided by the volume it is dissolved in
The total amount of concentrate used
